summary: Mobile-health Network Solutions filed a Form 6-K disclosing a non-binding strategic cooperation MOU with Hector Capital Holdings. Under the framework, Hector may invest up to US$119 million into the company to fund the potential acquisition of majority interests in BIMA and MM Helix. The MOU is non-binding and subject to full due diligence, definitive agreements, regulatory approval, and independent valuation. No specific price per share, premium, or board recommendation is provided; terms may include equity or convertible instruments. The filing is a foreign private issuer report; no US-equivalent event has occurred. The lack of binding terms and missing deal parameters makes completion uncertain, and investors should monitor definitive agreements and regulatory milestones.
